name: Flachiko
look: a grumpy red-and-white pup with a round head, a yellow face mask, pointed ears, a white flame-licked ruff, dark paws and a flame tail
entry: It scowls at everyone it meets, but its flame tail wags uncontrollably when it is happy. Its fur is warm enough to sleep against on cold nights.
how: One of the second A. Fakemon trio's starters: pick it at the starter screen (its A. Fakemon II page).
Wild: very rare in plains and savannas.
